description: Search upcoming meetups. Combine any of: free text (title, topic, organizer, venue; Hebrew or English, every word must match), a topic tag, a date range, a time window and exclude_paid. Tags: ai (AI), data (דאטה), cloud (תשתיות), security (סייבר), frontend (פרונט), startups (סטארטאפים), makers (מייקרים).

exclude_paid.description: Leave out meetups known to cost money. Most meetups are free.

when.description: Time window in Asia/Jerusalem: today, tomorrow, week (today + 6 days) or all upcoming.

name: search_meetups
title: Search meetups
